Who I Am

About Me

Hello! I'm Sakshi Manik Hande, a passionate IT Engineering student at Cummins College of Engineering for Women, Pune. I completed my Diploma in IT from Jaihind Polytechnic, Kuran with an outstanding 95.53%.

I build real software for real clients — currently developing a live inventory management system for Recharkha, a sustainable social startup in Pune. I have published a research paper on "Smart Car Parking System" in the IRJMETS International Journal (Impact Factor 8.187).

I have participated in hackathons, ideathons and state-level competitions. I am enthusiastic, determined and always eager to learn new technologies and make a meaningful impact through my work.
